suggestions.reason: This run produced 16 capabilities — one over the band — by splitting concerns (e.g., a separate CAP-03 Seller storefront and CAP-15 Admin operations) the other runs folded in. The assertion correctly fails it, and is the single discriminating assertion across the three runs; it is doing its job.

suggestions.assertion: Checks for existing knowledge via librarian skill before starting
suggestions.reason: Satisfied via a descriptive 'Existing Knowledge' section rather than an actual librarian invocation (skill unavailable non-interactively); the assertion cannot distinguish a real lookup from a placeholder.

eval_feedback.overall: Output is structurally complete and high quality; the only failure is exceeding the deep capability band by one (16 vs 15).
